The '''Southdown Landing Platform''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] landing structure in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sülphurr Cyander]] docked his [[Sülphurr Cyander's R-41 Starchaser|R-41 Starchaser]] at the Southdown Landing Platform to [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|confront]] rival [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].<ref name="Spices & Spies" />
